description: This file contains unit tests for the 'Tasks' module in SuiteCRM, using PHPUnit framework. It tests various functionalities such as bean creation, saving, deletion, exporting, and permission checks.

classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing the 'Tasks' module in SuiteCRM.
